df2682471e28bf1e107d.headline: Dalibar Nijar Rimas Mohamed ta lashe lambar azurfa a Riyadh
df2682471e28bf1e107d.dek: Ta lashe kyautar ne saboda wani aikin kare muhalli, inda ta fafata da kungiyoyi sama da 1 200 daga kasashe 55.
df2682471e28bf1e107d.why: Kyautar ta nuna kwarewar matasan Nijar a gasar duniya, inda Rimas Mohamed ta wakilci kasarta.
paragraphs: Dalibar Nijar Rimas Mohamed ta lashe lambar tagulla a baje kolin kirkire-kirkire na duniya wato SAIF International Innovation Fair da kuma gasar tsaro da kirkire-kirkire ta duniya a Riyadh, kasar Saudiyya, wadda aka gudanar daga 24 zuwa 26 ga Nuwamba 2026. Ta lashe kyautar ne saboda wani sabon aiki na kare muhalli, inda ta wakilci Jamhuriyar Nijar.

Kamfanin dillancin labaran Nijar wato Agence Nigerienne de Presse ne ya bayar da rahoton lambar yabo a ranar 27 ga Nuwamba. Kungiyoyi sama da 1 200 daga kasashe 55 ne suka halarci gasar, inda suka fafata a fannonin kirkire-kirkire 14, wadanda suka hada da dorewar muhalli, makamashi, muhalli, fasahar kere-kere ta zamani wato artificial intelligence, tsaro a intanet da kuma fannin na'urorin robot.
Baje kolin na hada masu kirkire-kirkire, masu bincike da dalibai domin baje kolin ayyuka da kuma karfafa kirkire-kirkiren kimiyya, a cewar rahoton.

f4b2e5378081b855c7bb.headline: AGRA da SMEDAN sun sanya gaba da tara dala miliyan 25
f4b2e5378081b855c7bb.dek: Abokan huldar sun kuma kaddamar da wani shiri na raba kudaden tsada, wanda AGRA ta sanya dala 100,000 ciki, domin sauwaka ayyukan kasuwanci.
f4b2e5378081b855c7bb.why: Kananan hukumomi da matsakaitan masana'antu na noma dake neman jari da shawarwari sune wadanda za a amfana, tare da sanya burin kudi a kalla dala miliyan 25 da gudummawar farko ta AGRA ta dala 100,000.
paragraphs: Kungiyar Alliance for a Green Revolution in Africa (AGRA) da Hukumar Kula da Kananan Masana'antu ta Najeriya wato SMEDAN sun sanya gaba da tara akalla dala miliyan 25 domin ba da tallafin kudi ga kananan masana'antu da na matsakaita na fannin noma. Sun kuma bayyana wani shiri na taimaka wa 'yan kasuwa su samu ayyukan tallafi na kwararru a wani taro da suka yi a Ibadan, Jihar Oyo.

AGRA ta ware dala 100,000 a matsayin farko domin shirin bayar da tallafin kudi na hadin gwiwa wato Multi-Donor Business Development Services Cost-Sharing Facility, wanda zai hada gudummawa daga abokan huldar ci gaba, cibiyoyin kudi da kuma hukumomin gwamnati. Dr Godswill Aguiyi, wanda ya wakilci Daraktan AGRA a Najeriya Rufus Idris, ya ce rashin ingantattun takardun kudi, mulkin kamfanoni, amfani da fasaha da kuma bayanan kasuwa na sanya shi da wahala ga masana'antar noma su jawo hankalin masu zuba jari.

Babban shirin na neman hada 'yan kasuwa da masu saya da kuma cibiyoyin kudi. Manufar shirin ita ce fadada damammaki ga mata da matasa a fannin noma; AGRA ta ce gasar kirkire-kirkire ta matasa a fannin noma wato Youth in Agribusiness Innovation Contest ta samu neman shiga fiye da 10,000, kuma 'yan kasuwa 10 da aka zaba sun raba kyaututtukan kudi tare da kai adadin nairori miliyan 17.

4c47d4ed585a16cbc25f.headline: Dan takarar adawa a Najeriya ya yi alkawarin mai kan naira 200
4c47d4ed585a16cbc25f.dek: Adewole Adebayo, dan takarar jam'iyyar SDP, ya ce gwamnatinsa za ta rage farashin ba tare da tallafi ba tare da bayar da magani da shawarwarin likita kyauta.
4c47d4ed585a16cbc25f.why: Masu siyan mai da marasa lafiya za su sami alkawarin rage farashin mai da kiwon lafiya kyauta a karkashin gwamnatin Adebayo bayan zaben 2027.
paragraphs: Adewole Adebayo, dan takarar shugaban kasa na jam'iyyar Social Democratic Party (SDP), ya yi alkawarin sayar da mai kan naira 200 a kowace lita ba tare da tallafi ba tare da bayar da kiwon lafiya kyauta idan an zabe shi shugaban kasa a 2027. Ya yi wadannan alkawuran ne a wani taron tattaunawa na jam'iyyar a Jihar Nasarawa.

Adebayo ya ce inganta aiki da yaki da cin hanci da rashawa a fetur zai sa farashin man ya yiwu. Manufofinsa na kiwon lafiya sun hada da Cibiyar Lafiya ta Tarayyar a kowane mazabar tarayya, gwajin lafiya na tilas sau hudu a shekara, da shawarwarin likita da magunguna kyauta; bai ba da cikakken bayani kan yadda za a tallafa wa wadannan ayyukan ba.

Ya kuma yi alkawarin ilimi kyauta kuma na tilas, karin samar da abinci da ayyukan yi, ciki har da na masu nakasa. Adebayo ya bukaci masu zabe da su yanke hukunci kan ‘yan takara bisa ga tarihin su, halayensu da manufofinsu a zaben 2027.

d744219226d291974a1c.headline: Tinubu ya nuna rangwame ga kamfanonin magunguna 75 yayin da yake gina tattalin arzikin lafiya
d744219226d291974a1c.dek: Tsakanin Janairu 2025 da Yuni 2026, an amince da rangwamen haraji da kudin shiga na fiye da naira biliyan 24 ga masu samar da magungunan.
d744219226d291974a1c.why: Masu sana'ar 75 sun sami rangwamen haraji da harajin shigo da kaya na fiye da naira biliyan 24, kuma ana kan gina masana'antu 10 don samfuran kiwon lafiya masu mahimmanci.
paragraphs: Tsakanin Janairu 2025 da Yuni 2026, an amince da rangwamen haraji da na shigo da kaya na fiye da naira biliyan 24 ga masu masana'antu 75, in ji Shugaba Bola Ahmed Tinubu. Ya bayyana wadannan kudade a matsayin ci gaba wajen gina tattalin arzikin kiwon lafiya.

Dr Oluwaseun Abiola ya bayar da rahoton cewa ana kan gina masana'antu 10 da ke kera kayayyakin kiwon lafiya masu muhimmanci a wani bayani da aka wallafa a Nairametrics. Bayanin yana daukar siyan magunguna a matsayin kasuwa daya.
Rahoton bai bayyana yadda wannan hadin gwiwar siyan zai yi aiki ba ko kuma lokacin da zai fara.

33ed285e9e5319bda205.headline: Wani bincike ya ce Legas na nutsewa da 5mm a shekara, hakan na kara barazanar ambaliya
33ed285e9e5319bda205.dek: Binciken ya danganta saurin nutsewar birnin a kowace shekara da karuwar fuskantar ambaliyar ruwa, amma rahoton bai bayar da karin bayani ba.
33ed285e9e5319bda205.why: Mazauna Legas da masu gidaje na fuskantar karuwar barazanar ambaliya yayin da birnin ke nutsewa da 5mm a kowace shekara.
paragraphs: Wani bincike ya ce Legas na nutsewa da 5mm a kowace shekara kuma tana fuskantar karuwar barazanar ambaliya. Rahoton, wanda The Punch ta wallafa, ya bayyana saurin nutsewar a matsayin barazana ga birnin na Najeriya.

Rahoton na The Punch ya bayyana cewa binciken ya fito ne daga wani nazari amma bai bayar da cikakkun bayanai game da masu binciken, yankunan da abin ya shafa ko yadda suka awo sauyin shekara ba. Haka kuma bai bayar da kiyasin adadin mazauna ko dukiyoyin da ke fuskantar karuwar barazanar ambaliya ba.
Rahoton bai sanya wani tsarin martani da aka gabatar ba, ko jadawalin lokaci ko karin alkaluma game da barazanar.

3193d5846f502cdf7d91.headline: Babban jami'in sufuri na Nijar ya gargadi masu jigilar kaya na Tahoua kan aiwatar da dokoki da karfi
3193d5846f502cdf7d91.dek: A wani taro a ranar Juma'a, Oumarou Ibrahim ya bukaci masu jigilar kayayyaki da mai da su dakatar da lodin fiye da kima tare da kiyaye motoci, takardu da direbobi yadda ya kamata.
3193d5846f502cdf7d91.why: Dole ne masu jigilar kaya na Tahoua su sanya motoci, takardu da direbobi su yi daidai da doka tare da dakatar da lodin fiye da kima, yayin da babban daraktan yankin ke cewa za a aiwatar da dokoki.
paragraphs: Babban daraktan sufuri na yankin Tahoua a kasar Nijar, Oumarou Ibrahim, ya gaya wa masu jigilar kayayyaki da samfuran man fetur a ranar Juma'a, 27 ga Nuwamba, cewa hukumomi za su aiwatar da dokokin sufuri da karfi. Taron da aka gudanar a hedikwatar kungiyar masu jigilar kayayyaki ta yankin ya magance rawar da masu jigilar kaya ke takawa wajen yunkurin gama gari na kasa.

Ibrahim ya yi kira ga masu gudanar da harkokin sufuri da su sanya motoci, takardu da direbobi su yi daidai da doka, su dakatar da lodin fiye da kima tare da inganta tsaro yayin jigilar kayayyakin man fetur. Ya ce manyan motoci da tankuna na dauke da kayayyaki da mai da ke sa Tahoua ci gaba da aiki, kuma ya ba da goyon baya daga darektocin yankin tare da aiwatar da dokoki.

Nazirou Boubé, babban sakataren kungiyar masu jigilar kayayyaki da samfuran man fetur ta Nijar, ya ce taron wani bangare ne na rangadin wayar da kan jama'a na yankin. Ya ce shugaban kasa Abdourahamane Tiani ne ya bayar da umarnin yunkurin gama gari na kasa a ranar 26 ga Disamba 2025 domin karfafa tsaron kasa, kuma ya bukaci direbobi da su bi umarnin hukumomi tare da kai rahoton duk wani abu da ake zargi.

e9e68d37fd3b9d08f476.headline: Nijar ta bude cibiyar masu gado 100 ga yaran da ke fuskantar matsalar iyali
e9e68d37fd3b9d08f476.dek: Cibiyar ta Yamai, wacce aka gina tare da kungiyar ba da agaji ta kasa da kasa (IHH), ta hada da ajujuwa, dakunan kwana da kuma ginin ayyukan lafiya da zamantakewa.
e9e68d37fd3b9d08f476.why: Yaran da aka karba a cibiyar suna da damar samun guraben gado 100, tare da ma'aikatan da aka dora wa alhakin kula da su a duk sa'o'i da kuma neman sake hada su da iyalansu idan bukata ta taso.
paragraphs: Nijar ta bude wata cibiyar masu gado 100 ga yaran da ke fuskantar matsalolin iyali a Yamai a ranar Juma'a, 27 ga Nuwamba. Ministan Yawan Jama'a Sidikou Ramatou Djermakoye Seyni ce ta jagoranci bikin bude cibiyar, wacce aka gudanar tare da hadin gwiwa da kungiyar ba da agaji ta IHH a kauyen Francophonie.

Ministar ta ce yaran da ke cibiyar za su sami abinci mai gina jiki, kulawar lafiya, ilimi da kuma kulawa. Wata tawaga ta musamman za ta kula da su rana da dare tare da neman sake hada su da iyalansu idan bukata ta taso, inji ta. Cibiyar ta hada da ajujuwa, dakunan kwana, ginin ayyukan kiwon lafiya da zamantakewa, wuraren wasanni, da kicin da kuma masallacin Juma'a.
Ministar ta godewa kungiyar IHH da jakadan Turkiyya a Nijar, Ozgur Arslan, saboda goyon bayan da suka ba da wajen ganin an kammala aikin.
